author: Maya S.
text: Has anyone taken Calculus with Professor Dania Zantut? I care most about clear lectures and fair grading.

comments.author: Omar K.
comments.text: Her lectures were very clear and the problem sets matched the exams. Office hours helped a lot.

comments.author: Lina A.
comments.text: I liked the course, but the weekly workload was heavier than I expected.

comments.author: Sam R.
comments.text: Fair grader in my semester. The midterm was difficult but there were no surprises.

author: Noor H.
text: For people who studied away in Paris, was it worth it academically and socially?

comments.author: Alex P.
comments.text: Absolutely worth it for the museums and travel. Classes were solid, though housing was expensive.

comments.author: Sara M.
comments.text: Great city and I made close friends, but budgeting was stressful and the commute took time.

author: Yousef T.
text: Which campus housing building is quietest for studying?

comments.author: Priya D.
comments.text: A2 was quiet on my floor and close to the library shuttle stop.

comments.author: Hana B.
comments.text: Noise depends more on the floor than the building. Ask housing for a room away from the lounge.
